propositions: Four criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic executions due to missing or overly broad trigger vocabulary.

Deterministic pre-filters must fire only when criterion-subject vocabulary is present in plan text or file_impact entries, allowing the unchanged LLM router to remain the applicability authority for fired plans.

Four audit-derived trigger vocabularies with conjunction support (text_all), glob-based file_impact matching, and reason-text regex matching must replace silent skips with visible gate_log entries in the coverage sidecar.
Asserted-capability requires conjunction of both text_all legs (module-ref and capability-verb) to fire; single-leg matches must not route.

Removal-rationale and leaf-routed criteria must be gated in a parallel _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table and orchestrator block, separate from the existing _DET_OVERLAY_RULES path for T13/T14 and T5a/T5d/T7/T12.
Existing T5a/T5d/T7/T12 regex rules must migrate to DetGateRule objects with identical fire/no-fire behavior on representative texts.
